name: Aleksandr Peskov
biography: In 1987 he graduated from the Moscow Art Theater School-Studio (workshop of V. Bogomolov). He played on the stages of the Moscow Art Theater named after Gorky (1987-1989), the Studio Theater on Spartakovskaya Square (1991). In 1993-1994 - actor of the Roman Viktyuk Theater. In 1994-1995 he played in the entreprise "Engagement". In 1996-2004 - actor of the theater named after A.S. Pushkin. Since 2004, he has been an actor of the Moon Theater under the direction of S. Prokhanov. He began acting in films since 1983.
